stem: A plant is already damaged before assigned canopy work begins. What should the technician do?
choices: Document/inspect the condition and follow the supplied hold or escalation rule before adding more stress if required
rationale: Document/inspect the condition and follow the supplied hold or escalation rule before adding more stress if required. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
